Things to do by hand

- Postcode (B08 and B18): the form wants the postcode in its own box. After your address goes back in, keep only the postal code in each "Postcode" box. You can also delete it from the address line next to it so it isn't written twice.
- Date of birth (B07): it goes back in the way your passport prints it. That's fine for this form. If the agent wants day/month/year in numbers, rewrite it that way by hand.
- Phone (B09): an Australian agent will be calling from overseas, so make sure the number starts with the Singapore country code (+65).
- Full name (B06): the form has no title box. If you want "Ms" shown, write it in front by hand.
- B18: I've assumed your home address is the Singapore flat you've rented since June 2021. If it isn't, write that flat's address in B18 instead. If you know the exact start date in June 2021, add it.

What I still need from you (NEEDS-YOU)

- B02: the address and postcode of the Brisbane flat.
- B10: your email address.
- B11–B14: your employment. You can use either job:
  - your current job in Singapore (employer, job title, how long you've worked there, gross weekly income, employer contact details), or
  - your new Brisbane nursing job starting 1 February 2027 (employer name and contact details, job title such as "Registered Nurse" or whatever your contract says, "Starting 1 February 2027" as the length, and the weekly gross pay from your offer).
  As a new arrival, the second option usually helps more. Attach your signed offer letter or contract under item 7.
- B20: the name, email and phone of your Singapore landlord or agent.
- B21: the rental before June 2021, if you had one. If you didn't, leave Property 2 blank. You can describe how you lived before then in B22 (for example, living with family).
- B23–B24: two referees, each with a name, phone, email and how they know you. A former landlord, your current or new employer, or a colleague all work well.

Documents to have ready

These are for when the agent fills in items 7 to 9:
- your passport (Philippine, valid until 13 March 2032)
- your job offer or employment contract
- recent payslips or bank statements (without transaction details)
- a rental reference from your Singapore landlord

The agent may also ask to see your Australian visa grant.
